svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.24k stars in total, about 1.07k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 457, aube 2024, fnox 2220, hk 1236, pitchfork 676, usage 1051, +5 more 578.
